---
title: "Polynesia Mana Overview"
---

Script to retrieve Mean Coral Cover values between 2016 and 2024 for Haapiti & E2B (used for size analysis).

```{r}
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
dat_mana <- read.csv(here("long_term/data/raw/polynesia_mana.csv")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2023-12-31"),
    site %in% c("e2b", "haapiti")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    year = annee,
    site,
    n_quadrat,
    genus = genre,
    cover = recouvrement
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, site, genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover))
```

Average benthic cover

```{r}
dat_mana %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_cover_g = mean(mean_cover)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_cover_g))
```
